# The pinned sources of the KVM layer's tests, at the revisions task 80-2
# measured Linux's KVM with on the Lenovo (dev-log/80-games/80-2.md, whose
# tools/lenovo/debian-ref/SHA256SUMS has the same two digests). Each line
# gives a name, version, URL and SHA-256, in the format of ../sources.txt;
# build_kvm.sh fetches and checks each with ../debian/fetch_asset.sh.
#
# kvm-unit-tests is GitLab's archive of commit
# 5a221342a025948fa7d84f0c404748f6ba57f3ad, which nobody signs. Its files
# were compared with a clone of
# https://gitlab.com/kvm-unit-tests/kvm-unit-tests.git checked out at that
# commit, and are the same. GitLab may pack the same commit differently
# later; the commit is the pin, and a new archive of it needs a new digest.
#
# Linux 6.12.115 is the release whose selftests 80-2 built: the tarball's
# signature, linux-6.12.115.tar.sign over the uncompressed tar, verified
# with Greg Kroah-Hartman's key, 647F28654894E3BD457199BE38DBBDC86092693E,
# and kernel.org's sha256sums.asc, whose signature verified with its checksum
# autosigner's key, B8868C80BA62A1FFFAF5FDA9632D3A06589DA6B1, lists the same
# digest.

linux-kvm-selftests 6.12.115 https://cdn.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/v6.x/linux-6.12.115.tar.xz 0ec90fe4b20422b1b664b77e6d2dde22b40bd41e7eb2cad8ac8739a4749cb1bb
